service_errors.denied: Your {service} account didn't allow this. Reconnect it in Preferences > Integrations, then try again.
service_errors.denied.change: Your {service} account can't make this change in the repository. Ask its owner for access, or sign in with another account.
service_errors.denied.create_repo: Your {service} account can't create repositories on {owner}. Choose another owner, or ask an owner of {owner} for access.
service_errors.denied.fork: Your {service} account can't fork this repository. Its owner may have turned forking off, or your account may need access.
service_errors.network: Glowfly couldn't reach {service}. Check your network connection, then try again.
service_errors.not_found.owner: {service} can't find {owner} for your account. Choose another owner.
service_errors.not_found.repo: {service} can't find this repository for your account. Check that you're signed in with an account that can see it.
service_errors.rate_limited: {service} is limiting requests from your account. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
service_errors.repo_exists: A repository called {name} already exists on {owner}. Choose another name.
service_errors.server: {service} had a problem on its side. Try again in a few minutes.
service_errors.sign_in: {service} didn't accept your sign-in. Sign in again, or reconnect the account in Preferences > Integrations.
service_errors.sign_in_again.help: Sign in again in Preferences > Integrations.
